name: dream-makeover-pos
description: Offline-first luxury beauty salon POS and business management system

scripts.desktop:dev: concurrently --kill-others "npm run dev --workspace frontend -- --host localhost" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && npm run dev --workspace desktop"
scripts.desktop:package:win: npm run build --workspace frontend && npm run build --workspace desktop && electron-builder --projectDir . --config desktop/electron-builder.yml --win nsis
scripts.ci:all: npm run lint && npm run type-check && npm run test && npm run build
